title: Degree-one Love numbers

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: Compute the degree 1 loading Love numbers, in normal mode or time-domain form, expressed in the centre of mass reference frame. Degree 1 has fewer modes than degrees 2 and above.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. For a converted test, the files read and what each column holds are in the `files` table of gia_mip/resources/spada_column_layouts.json. `not_converted` gives, per contributor, the reason its data is not in the converted file.

not_converted.GS: T01-07/Gs/ holds h.dat, l.dat, k.dat and *_time_domain.dat. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not degree-one Love numbers in the time domain, so this test has no reader yet.
not_converted.GSA: T01-07/Gsa/ holds [hlk]-alma-deg1.dat. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not degree-one Love numbers in the time domain, so this test has no reader yet.
not_converted.RR: T01-07/ holds h_Rr.dat, l_Rr.dat and k_Rr.dat, and riva-T01-deg1_inc/. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not degree-one Love numbers in the time domain, so this test has no reader yet.
not_converted.VB: T01-07/ holds h_Vb.dat, l_Vb.dat, k_Vb.dat and Vb/M3-L70-V01_t01-07-VALE.txt. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not degree-one Love numbers in the time domain, so this test has no reader yet.
not_converted.VK: T01-07/ holds h_Vk.dat, l_Vk.dat and the files of Vk/. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not degree-one Love numbers in the time domain, so this test has no reader yet.
